name: Changelings
description: Lorwyn's harmless, semi-intelligent shapeshifters who involuntarily take the shape of nearby creatures and plants.

description_citations.text: "Shapeshifter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Oona's downfall, changelings remain in Lorwyn unless driven into Shadowmoor.
timeline.quote: Since Oona's downfall, changelings remain in Lorwyn unless they are driven into Shadowmoor unwillingly.
